desktop: Use case: ads-marketing. ASSET: DearBody Philippines six-scent homepage desktop campaign. PURPOSE: begin a warm premium playful fragrance journey from London to Filipino everyday life. Image 2 is Charme Envoûtant (orange), Rtulle & Satin (turquoise), Oud Mirage (blue/lilac), all black labels. Preserve the exact cylindrical glass shapes, cap heights and ribbing, liquid colors, label typography, product names, tiny original monogram and PARFUM LONDON detail, relative proportions. MODEL: no people. COMPOSITION: commercial studio photograph, six full bottles staged at different heights on tactile warm cream architectural pedestals concentrated on the RIGHT 60 percent, natural asymmetric grouping, no overlap obscuring labels. Layered burnt orange and burgundy architectural surfaces near far right. Soft gold highlights, one subtle translucent gauze textile. BACKGROUND: warm cream #F4E3CB with burgundy #5C0006, warm red #9A1106, burnt orange #D46601 and peach gold #E9A250 accents. LIGHT: golden directional studio light and dimensional editorial shadows. MOOD: warm, bold, premium, modern, approachable. NEGATIVE SPACE: left 40 percent clean pale warm cream for live HTML heading. RATIO: landscape approximately 1.8:1, high resolution. STRICT PRODUCT LOCK: reproduce packaging exactly from supplied original bottle reference photos; no redesigned labels, recolored bottles, changed caps or fake marks. No website headlines, no marketing copy, no added decorative letters or text, no flags. Bottles upright, editorial photographic realism, not illustration.
